name: Sacrificial stones (start)
description: The ring of standing stones where every new player arrives. It holds the stones for each Forsaken trophy and a Vegvisir pointing to Eikthyr, with berries, mushrooms, branches and stones nearby.
veteranNotes: Placed first, searching outward from the centre, and always in the Meadows. It contains seven boss stones (Eikthyr to Fader), the start platform and Vegvisir_Eikthyr.
notes: Search starts at the centre and grows outward; must be Meadows. Observed 71-228 m from centre (S-LOC-02).

name: Eikthyr altar
description: The altar where you summon Eikthyr, the first boss. Offer two deer trophies here to start the fight.
veteranNotes: A small location with a deer statue and Eikthyr. Up to 3 are attempted within 1000 m of the centre.

name: The Elder altar
description: The overgrown altar of The Elder, the Black Forest boss. Offer three ancient seeds here to summon him.
veteranNotes: Holds the seed statue, The Elder and a boss runestone. Placed 1000-7000 m from the centre, at least 3000 m apart.

name: Bonemass altar
description: Bonemass's altar deep in the Swamp. Offer ten withered bones here to summon him.
veteranNotes: Holds Bonemass and a boss runestone; placed at least 2000 m from the centre and 3000 m apart.

name: Moder altar
description: Moder's altar high on a mountain peak. Place three dragon eggs here to summon her.
veteranNotes: Holds Moder and a boss runestone. Placed within 8000 m of the centre, 150-500 m altitude, 3000 m apart.
notes: Altitude interpreted as metres above sea level (S-WG-13 names the minAltitude/maxAltitude fields; the reference point is an open verification item).

name: Yagluth altar
description: The ruined altar of Yagluth on the Plains. Offer five fuling totems here to summon him.
veteranNotes: The location file lists only Yagluth himself; up to 4 are attempted, at least 3000 m apart.

name: Infested Citadel (The Queen)
description: A sealed dvergr fortress in the Mistlands where The Queen lives. You need a sealbreaker to open it, and seekers guard the halls inside.
veteranNotes: Needs the DvergrKey (sealbreaker). Holds The Queen, a boss hint runestone, 4 seeker spawners, dvergr lanterns and tankards. Placed in groups at least 2048 m apart, below 20 m altitude.

name: Fader altar
description: Fader's ruined arena in the Ashlands, ringed by broken walls and charred graves. This is where you summon and fight Fader.
veteranNotes: Holds Fader among ruined walls and pillars with many charred grave stones. Below 300 m altitude, at least 2048 m apart.
notes: Quantity conflict: S-LOC-01 lists 5, S-LOC-02 lists 3 (open verification item 4). Left null, so approx-v1 does not place it.

name: Deep North boss location (Kall Fimbulbringer)
description: The icy cave arena of Kall Fimbulbringer, the Deep North boss, behind a great gate with an offering altar outside.
veteranNotes: The DN_Bossroom file lists FrozenKing, the LastBossGate with chains and pillars, a rune tablet and an offering altar, at 80 m altitude or higher.
notes: Prefab conflict: DN_Bossroom (S-LOC-01 location file, S-VER-15) vs FrozenKing (kirilloid objects.ts). Open verification item 3.

name: Haldor (trader)
description: The camp of Haldor, the travelling merchant. He sells useful gear such as Megingjord and the fishing rod in exchange for coins.
veteranNotes: One camp is kept per world, at least 1500 m from the centre. It holds Haldor, Halstein, a wagon, trader runestones and barrels.

name: Hildir (trader)
description: The camp of Hildir, a merchant of clothes, hats and fireworks. Her missing chests are guarded by minibosses elsewhere in the world.
veteranNotes: One camp per world, at least 3000 m from the centre. Holds Hildir, her lox, three chest stands and trader runestones; part of her stock unlocks after Brenna, Geirrhafa or Zil and Thungr are defeated.
notes: Max distance unresolved (S-LOC-02 says 8000; S-LOC-01 lists none), open verification item 5.

name: Bog Witch (trader)
description: The camp of the Bog Witch in the Swamp. She trades cooking ingredients and spices for coins; her creature Kvastur stays nearby.
veteranNotes: One camp per world, 3000-8000 m from the centre. Holds the Bog Witch, Kvastur and talismans.

name: Smouldering Tomb (Brenna)
description: The Smouldering Tomb, a burial chamber where the fiery skeleton Brenna guards one of Hildir's chests.
veteranNotes: A forest crypt layout with Skeleton_Hildir (Brenna), who drops Hildir's brass chest and her trophy. At least 3000 m from the centre.

name: Howling Cavern (Geirrhafa)
description: The Howling Cavern, a frost cave where the cultist Geirrhafa guards one of Hildir's chests.
veteranNotes: A cave layout with Fenring_Cultist_Hildir (Geirrhafa), who drops Hildir's silver chest. At least 200 m altitude and 1000 m from the centre.

name: Sealed Tower (Zil & Thungr)
description: The Sealed Tower, a fuling fortress where the brothers Zil and Thungr guard one of Hildir's chests.
veteranNotes: Holds GoblinShaman_Hildir (Zil), GoblinBrute_Hildir (Thungr) and the combined GoblinBruteBros entry; Zil and Thungr drop Hildir's bronze chest. At least 8 m altitude, 3000 m apart.

name: Place of Mystery 1
description: A mysterious Ashlands tomb guarded by charred warriors. One of the Dyrnwyn sword fragments rests here, with molten cores nearby.
veteranNotes: Holds the Dyrnwyn tip fragment (Pickable_Swordpiece3), an elite charred stone spawner and up to 4 molten core stands. One per world.

name: Place of Mystery 2
description: A mysterious Ashlands tomb guarded by charred warriors. One of the Dyrnwyn sword fragments rests here, with molten cores nearby.
veteranNotes: Holds the Dyrnwyn blade fragment (Pickable_Swordpiece2), an elite charred stone spawner and up to 4 molten core stands. One per world.

name: Tomb of Lord Reto
description: The tomb of Lord Reto, a powerful charred warrior. Defeating him yields the hilt of the sword Dyrnwyn.
veteranNotes: Holds an elite charred stone spawner and Spawner_Charred_Dyrnwyn (Lord Reto, level 3). Lord Reto drops the Dyrnwyn hilt fragment.

name: Burial Chambers
description: A Burial Chamber: a small stone crypt in the Black Forest with skeletons, ghosts and treasure. It is also a good early source of surtling cores and bone fragments.
veteranNotes: Forest crypt rooms hold skeletons, rancid remains, a ghost, bone pile spawners, surtling core stands, yellow mushrooms, chests and in some rooms a Vegvisir to The Elder (40%).

name: Burial Chambers
description: A Burial Chamber: a small stone crypt in the Black Forest with skeletons, ghosts and treasure. It is also a good early source of surtling cores and bone fragments.
veteranNotes: Same forest crypt room set as the other burial chambers; the entrance has up to 3 skeletons.

name: Burial Chambers
description: A Burial Chamber: a small stone crypt in the Black Forest with skeletons, ghosts and treasure. It is also a good early source of surtling cores and bone fragments.
veteranNotes: Same forest crypt room set as the other burial chambers; the entrance has up to 3 skeletons.

name: Troll Cave
description: A cave in a Black Forest hillside that a troll calls home. Inside you may find treasure chests and yellow mushrooms.
veteranNotes: Holds one troll (plus a 33% chance of another), up to 2 troll-cave chests (75% each), yellow mushrooms and random crypt loot.

name: Sunken Crypt
description: A flooded stone crypt in the Swamp, locked until you have the swamp key from The Elder. Inside are draugr, blobs, muddy scrap piles full of iron and treasure.
veteranNotes: Needs the CryptKey (swamp key). Rooms hold draugr, elite draugr, blobs, muddy scrap piles, chests and sometimes a Vegvisir to Bonemass (40-50% per room).

name: Frost Cave
description: A deep ice cave in the Mountains. Cultists, ulvs and bats live inside, and it is rich in crystals, obsidian and fenris hair.
veteranNotes: Cave rooms hold ulv spawners, bats, cultists, stone golem spawners, crystals, obsidian, meat piles, fenris hair and chests with upgrade idols; some rooms have a Vegvisir to Moder (25%).

name: Infested Mine
description: An Infested Mine: a dvergr mine taken over by seekers. Black cores, sealbreaker fragments and royal jelly are found inside.
veteranNotes: Dvergr town rooms hold seeker and seeker soldier spawners, ticks, seeker eggs, black core stands, crystal altars (sealbreaker fragments), chests and royal jelly; the entrance lists 5 seeker spawners.
notes: A Vegvisir to the Queen can appear inside Infested Mine rooms (20% per room per S-LOC-01), not per location.

name: Infested Mine
description: An Infested Mine: a dvergr mine taken over by seekers. Black cores, sealbreaker fragments and royal jelly are found inside.
veteranNotes: Same dvergr town room set as the other infested mine; the entrance lists 2 seeker spawners plus 2 more at 50%.

name: Putrid Hole
description: A Putrid Hole: a pit in the Ashlands where a morgen lurks. Some of them hold a Vegvisir that points to the Places of Mystery.
veteranNotes: Holds a Morgen and a 25% Vegvisir_placeofmystery_1.

name: Putrid Hole
description: A Putrid Hole: a pit in the Ashlands where a morgen lurks. Some of them hold a Vegvisir that points to the Places of Mystery.
veteranNotes: Holds a Morgen and a 25% Vegvisir_placeofmystery_2.

name: Putrid Hole
description: A Putrid Hole: a pit in the Ashlands where a morgen lurks. Some of them hold a Vegvisir that points to the Places of Mystery.
veteranNotes: Holds a Morgen and a 25% Vegvisir_placeofmystery_3.

name: Mörkhalla
description: Mörkhalla, a dark underground hall in the Deep North guarded by jotun warriors and witches. It holds rich treasure, ancient gemstones and weapon moulds.
veteranNotes: Morkhalla rooms hold krigen and hexen (plus spawners), ancient chests with gemstones and black cores, Mörkhalla chests with upgrade idols, and a Vegvisir to the Deep North boss in some rooms.

name: Deep North sinkhole house
description: A wooden house in the Deep North built over a sinkhole that leads down into tunnels. Eyeless ones wait in the dark, near frostcores and glowing larvae.
veteranNotes: The hole rooms hold eyeless one spawners, luminous larvae, frostcore hangers, runestones and Spawner_Hole piles with moulds; the house itself has timber-hall loot.
notes: Probably the Winding Tunnels entrance (inferred; open verification item 6).

name: The Darkest Hole
description: A deep, dark pit in the Deep North. Glowing larvae can be picked inside.
veteranNotes: The kirilloid location file marks this location as disabled; it lists only glow-worm pickables (60%, up to 6) and rock walls.

name: Draugr village
description: An abandoned farming village in the Meadows, overrun by draugr. It has beehives and treasure chests, but the undead are much tougher than normal Meadows creatures.
veteranNotes: Village buildings hold draugr, ranged draugr and elite draugr spawners, draugr piles, beehives and Meadows chests. Placed 2000-10000 m from the centre.

name: Fuling village
description: A walled fuling camp on the Plains. Fulings, berserkers and shamans defend chests of black metal scrap, and wild barley and flax grow inside.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 20 fulings (50%), 4 berserkers and 4 shamans (75%), 3 heath chests, flax, barley and up to 3 fuling totems (60% each).

name: Abandoned village
description: An abandoned village in the Deep North. Its houses hold chests, a granary and a timber hall with supplies and weapon moulds.
veteranNotes: North village camp pieces hold Deep North village chests, granary loot (seeds, flax, barley, moulds) and timber hall loot (food, moulds).

name: Ruin (Vegvisir: The Elder)
description: A small stone ruin in the Black Forest, often surrounded by greydwarfs. It may hold a chest and a Vegvisir that points to The Elder.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 5 greydwarfs, a chance of a brute, a 30% chest, a 30% barrel and a 30% Vegvisir_GDKing.

name: Tower ruin (Vegvisir: The Elder)
description: A ruined stone tower in the Black Forest with skeletons and greydwarfs. It may hold a Vegvisir that points to The Elder.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 6 skeletons, greydwarfs, 2 Black Forest chests, a beehive (28%) and a 30% Vegvisir_GDKing.

name: Swamp ruin (Vegvisir: Bonemass)
description: A crumbling stone ruin in the Swamp, haunted by draugr. It may hold a chest and a Vegvisir that points to Bonemass.
veteranNotes: Holds draugr (50%), an elite draugr (32%), a draugr pile spawner, a 25% swamp chest and a 30% Vegvisir_Bonemass.

name: Swamp ruin (Vegvisir: Bonemass)
description: A crumbling stone ruin in the Swamp, haunted by draugr. It may hold a chest and a Vegvisir that points to Bonemass.
veteranNotes: Holds draugr (50%), an elite draugr (32%), a draugr pile spawner, green torches, a 25% swamp chest and a 30% Vegvisir_Bonemass.

name: Mountain watchtower (Vegvisir: Moder)
description: A ruined watchtower on a mountainside, guarded by draugr. It may hold a chest and a Vegvisir that points to Moder.
veteranNotes: Holds 3 draugr, a Mountains chest (66%) and Vegvisir_DragonQueen (70% in the location file).

name: Stone henge (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A large ring of standing stones on the Plains, guarded by fuling berserkers. It holds a chest and may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds 1-3 fuling berserkers, a stone chest and a 40% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Stone henge (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A large ring of standing stones on the Plains, guarded by fuling berserkers. It holds a chest.
veteranNotes: Holds 1-3 fuling berserkers and a stone chest. The kirilloid file for this variant lists no Vegvisir, although our existing record gives 0.4 (to be verified).

name: Stone henge (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A large ring of standing stones on the Plains, guarded by fuling berserkers. It holds a chest and may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds 1-3 fuling berserkers, a stone chest and a 40% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Stone henge (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A ring of standing stones on the Plains, sometimes guarded by fuling berserkers. It may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 2 fuling berserkers (50%) and a 40% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Stone henge (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A small ring of standing stones on the Plains where fulings gather. It may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 3 fulings (54% each) and a 40% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Stone henge
description: A ring of standing stones on the Plains. It is a landmark only, with no guards or loot listed.
veteranNotes: The location file lists only rocks; no creatures, chests or Vegvisir.

name: Stone tower (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A tall stone tower on the Plains occupied by fulings. It holds a chest and may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 9 fulings (54% each), a heath chest and a 25% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Stone tower (Vegvisir: Yagluth)
description: A tall stone tower on the Plains occupied by fulings. It holds a chest and may hold a Vegvisir that points to Yagluth.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 12 fulings (54% each), a heath chest and a 25% Vegvisir_GoblinKing.

name: Charred Fortress (Vegvisir: Fader)
description: A large charred fortress in the Ashlands, defended by charred warlocks, marksmen and ballistas. It holds the bell fragment altar, treasure and a Vegvisir to Fader.
veteranNotes: Holds charred warlocks and marksmen, charred cross spawners, up to 4 ballistas (80%), 2 fortress chests (flametal ore, gemstones), molten core stands, Charred_altar_bellfragment and a Vegvisir_Fader entry.

name: Charred ruin (Vegvisir: Fader)
description: A charred ruin in the Ashlands with ash vines and ash crows. It may hold a Vegvisir that points to Fader.
veteranNotes: Holds 6 ash vines (vineberries), ash crows and a 10% Vegvisir_Fader.

name: Memorial site
description: A memorial site in the Deep North with graves, buried chests and an offering altar. The location data places a Vegvisir to the Deep North boss here.
veteranNotes: Holds crypt remains, up to 5 buried memorial chests (weapon moulds), a memorial runestone, Vegvisir_DNBoss and an offering altar (comment: FallenWarrior).
notes: S-LOC-01 puts Vegvisir_DNBoss here; guides say it is at the bottom of Mörkhalla (open verification item 3), so revealsLocationIds is left out.

name: Runestone
description: A standing runestone with a short piece of lore. Reading it can teach you something about this biome; it is harmless in itself.
veteranNotes: The location holds a single RuneStone object; no creatures or loot are listed. Danger comes only from the surrounding biome.

name: Surtling geyser
description: A bubbling fire geyser in the Swamp that keeps spawning surtlings, small fire creatures that drop surtling cores and coal.
veteranNotes: Lists 3 surtlings; the spawner comment says one respawns every 5 minutes. Up to 75 per world, at least 16 m apart.

name: Tar pit
description: A sticky tar pit on the Plains. Collect tar here, but watch out for the growths that rise from it.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 7 growths (50%), 2 growth respawners, 4 large tar pickables and 12 small ones.

name: Tar pit
description: A sticky tar pit on the Plains. Collect tar here, but watch out for the growths that rise from it.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 7 growths (50%), 2 growth respawners, 4 large tar pickables and 8 small ones.

name: Tar pit
description: A sticky tar pit on the Plains. Collect tar here, but watch out for the growths that rise from it.
veteranNotes: Holds up to 7 growths (50%), 2 growth respawners, 4 large tar pickables and 8 small ones.

name: Giant skeleton
description: The bones of a fallen giant in the Mistlands. Mine them for black marble, soft tissue and scrap metal, but ticks may be waiting.
veteranNotes: Holds giant ribs, skull and brain, a 25% giant sword, and tick spawners (50%, up to 5). Parts need a tier 3 pickaxe.

name: Giant skeleton
description: The rib cage of a fallen giant in the Mistlands, a good source of black marble.
veteranNotes: The location lists only giant ribs, which need a tier 3 pickaxe and give black marble.

name: Dvergr lighthouse
description: A dvergr lighthouse in the Mistlands, manned by dvergr with crossbows and magic. Their lanterns and supplies are kept here.
veteranNotes: Holds dvergr lanterns (75%), tankards, arbalest and mage spawners, a dvergr guard stone and a long crate with a dvergr extractor.
